## Checklist
- [ ] ADR updated if architecture changes
- [ ] Threat model considered
- [ ] Observability signals added (logs/metrics)
- [ ] OpenAPI/docs updated if API behavior changed
- [ ] Tests added or updated for behavior changes
- [ ] Branch is up to date with `main`
- [ ] Supply-chain impact considered (deps/actions/secrets)
- [ ] Release-note impact considered (semantic commit scope/type)
- [ ] Auth/RBAC impact considered for admin/moderation endpoints
